roamingDeferred.reason: The ladenetz and external-partner prices are eMSP roaming products. Keep them separate from physical Albwerk CPO offers and never attach them to third-party operators.

adHocDeferred.reason: The current official page says the applicable price is displayed before the charging process, but it does not publish a universal ad-hoc price. Do not infer the charging-card tariff.

networkEvidence.policy: Attach both charging-card offers only to physical Albwerk sites. Re-audit if a site outside Baden-Württemberg appears.

note: Current official price sheet checked 2026-09-01 and valid since 2024-12-01. At Albwerk's own ENERGIE TO GO charging points, the card tariff is 0.40 EUR/kWh AC and 0.50 EUR/kWh DC with a 2.99 EUR monthly fee per card. The official current page explicitly states that own-network sessions have no blocking fee. The card contract runs for one month and renews one month at a time unless cancelled under the published terms.
